title: Cluster Support Engineer
description: Cluster Support Engineer Blue Waters Products Ltd. Trincity Not disclosed Permanent full-time Updated 11/11/2026 Human Resource Apply Now Share Share this job Facebook Twitter Report This Job Save Save The incumbent drives plant operational excellence by analyzing performance, downtime, losses and non-conformances, identifying inefficiencies, recommending process improvements, and ensuring corrective action plans are completed. Purpose & Objective The Cluster Support Engineer drives continuous improvement in the performance of Plant Operations through the assessment of Plant activities and processes, the analysis of downtime, non-conformances, operational losses and through the follow up of identified action plans to completion. The job holder will report on Plant inefficiencies and make recommendations for process improvement. . Key Responsibilities Provide daily updates to the production performance (immediate and cumulative) Production Volumes against Target Downtime Review and provide report on monthly expenses against Production to determine Operational Cost per Case (using methods as guided by Chief Executive Officer) Provide data (trends, comparatives) to support Operations Weekly Review Meeting Lead the cross-functional team of the assigned Cluster in this task identifying causes of major downtime, non-conformances or losses. Determine root causes failures using applicable Root Cause Analysis techniques and determine actions to prevent recurrences. Determine practical and cost-effective actions to prevent recurrences of major downtime, non-conformances or losses. Push for the on-time completion of Action Plan Items by the responsible parties including providing any necessary support to facilitate completion. Implement systems to ensure timely alerts to responsible parties for on time completion of action plan items including face to face interactions. Analyze and identify opportunities to: reduce process variation improve process capabilities optimize process performance Develop plant improvement initiatives to increase operational efficiency and productivity. Qualifications & Experience Degree in Industrial or Production Engineering, Mechanical or Electrical Engineering. Master’s degree in production engineering and management would be considered an asset. Certification in Lean Management or Six Sigma Certificate or equivalent would be considered an Asset. Minimum of two years’ experience as an Engineer working in a manufacturing environment. Beverage industry experience would be considered an asset. Why Join Blue Waters? Opportunity to influence people strategy and organizational culture. Lead impactful employee engagement and talent retention initiatives. Work with a team committed to excellence and continuous improvement. Play a key role in supporting our mission to Never Disappoint the Customer . Kindly submit your application by November 25, 2026.
